title: Couch Potato
html:
Couch Potato
Skill Type:  Passive
Trainer:  Mage
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  2227
Increases Mana per point of Intellect and adds 5 to Strength and Intellect. Decreases Health per point of Endurance and reduces Agility and Endurance by 5.

Couch Potato is a Passive skill that increases Mana gained per point of Intellect but decreases Health gained per point of Endurance. The skill is best suited for a character in need of a larger mana pool that can stand to loose Health and Agility. Particularly, this skill is helpful in creating a Battle Mage build that combines Figher and Mage type skills.


This skill currently only has one level, so it can not be upgraded from skill trainers. Below is the description as it appears in the game.


"When you turn on the magi-vision with the 'mystical' remote, it winds you. The magi-vision has infused your brain with countless tidbits of 'useful' information, giving you additional Intellect and Mana per point of Intellect. Unfortunately, sitting around on the couch doing a whole lot of nothing has decreased your Health per Endurance as well as your overall Endurance. Curling the remote control has given you a boost in Strength but your Agility has suffered a bit from all the sitting.

  • +20% Mana per Intellect
  • +5 Strength
  • +5 Intellect
  • -5% Health per Endurance
  • -5 Agility
  • -5 Endurance
